title: Dropping Things Into The Sun is Hard....
summary: Scott Manley uses a realistically scaled Kerbal Space Program setup to show why dropping something into the Sun is far harder than it sounds. It demonstrates the need to cancel orbital velocity.
why: Cited whenever someone suggests launching nuclear waste or other junk into the Sun, as a clear demonstration of the orbital mechanics involved.

quote.text: Or watch Scott Manley demonstrate the unreasonable orbital dynamics you just described.
